name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multiline form field reusing the shared .hbd-field chrome (label + input-wrapper + footer): native <textarea> with optional auto-resize (height from scrollHeight), manual vertical resize, hint/error/success footer messages, and a tri-state character counter (default -> warning at >=80% -> over at >=100% of maxLength). sm/md/lg sizes; error/success/disabled/readonly state modifiers. Controlled-first (value + onValueChange) with uncontrolled defaultValue fallback. hbd:input -> onInput and hbd:change -> onChange callbacks receive { value, name }. aria-describedby wires hint/error/success/count ids; aria-invalid + role=alert/status on messages.
